searchLog: 17th consecutive day of the same network-egress failure (logged 2026-09-22 through 2026-10-06, now 2026-10-07 too). Re-verified independently before giving up: tested curl and WebFetch directly against ~13 domains spanning every category -- Greenhouse (job-boards.greenhouse.io, boards-api.greenhouse.io), Ashby (jobs.ashbyhq.com, api.ashbyhq.com), and company sites (databricks.com, sierra.ai, metacareers.com, microsoft careers, google.com, openai.com, apple jobs, stripe.com) -- plus two domains with zero job-board relevance (en.wikipedia.org, example.com) specifically to confirm this is a blanket allowlist, not a job-board-specific block. Every single one returned EGRESS_BLOCKED / 403 CONNECT-tunnel-failed. The only reachable domain, in this run as in prior ones, was www.anthropic.com itself -- confirming target-companies.json's existing note that Anthropic has no new-grad pipeline (Applied AI Architect / Commercial and Partnerships reqs, TPM Infrastructure req, and FDE reqs are all non-US-new-grad-eligible per that page, consistent with prior runs). WebSearch still works (unaffected by the egress proxy) and was used to sanity-check one target, Databricks' Associate Product Manager New Grad 2027 posting, which looks like a strong role-family-#4 fit on search snippets alone -- but per the hunt's own rule a snippet or aggregator listing is never sufficient grounds to include an opportunity; only a fetched, confirmed application page qualifies, and databricks.com is blocked, so it was not added. Zero verified opportunities is the correct and honest output for the 17th straight day. This is conclusively a persistent environment network-policy restriction on this routine's WebFetch/curl egress (not transient, not fixable by retrying tomorrow): it needs a human to widen the egress allowlist for the life-hub-daily hunt routine to cover standard job-board domains (Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever, Workable) and company career/program sites.
